title: Insight scene and logic layering
answers: How are insight scenes and logics wired?
Which logic owns insight URL/mode vs query data?
body:
- frontend/src/scenes/insights/InsightScene.tsx:InsightScene is the SceneExport (logic: insightSceneLogic); renders InsightAsScene with attachTo={insightSceneLogic}.
- insightSceneLogic.tsx: URL + mode owner (urlToAction / actionToUrl for setInsightId, setInsightMode).
- insightLogic.tsx: keyed insight model (keyForInsightLogicProps in sharedUtils.ts), loaders, dashboard overrides, insightProps selector.
- insightDataLogic.tsx: query/data side, isInsightSceneInstance.
- insightVizDataLogic.ts: derived query state (display, breakdown, legend); DISPLAYS_WITH_IN_CHART_LEGEND.
- Per-type logics live in products/product_analytics/frontend/insights/* (trends/trendsDataLogic.ts, funnels/funnelDataLogic.ts, retention/retentionLogic.ts), used as xLogic(insightProps).
- All logics keyed by insightProps; InsightViz mounts/binds them so children useValues(insightLogic) without props.
says: How are the insight scene and its business logic structured in code?
Where do I find code for different insight types like trends or funnels?
Which piece of code manages the insight's URL and display type settings?
How is insight data logic separated from visualization and URL handling?
Where are the per-visualization-type logics implemented for different insight displays?
